remarks: Stunning and Stylish. Step into this beautifully renovated 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo, where modern design meets ultimate comfort. Boasting a spacious, open floor plan, this condo features a brand-new kitchen equipped with gleaming stainless steel appliances, sleek quartz countertops, and plenty of space to cook and entertain. The newly updated bathroom includes a luxurious shower. Full-sized in-unit laundry room adds extra convenience and storage. Bask in natural light in the bright, airy living area that opens onto a large private balcony - the perfect spot to unwind and soak in breathtaking sunset views. With one covered, assigned parking space, you'll always have peace of mind. Located in the heart of Springdale, this prime spot puts you just three blocks from the train station and steps away from shopping, dining, and entertainment options. Assessment fully paid off by owner, resulting in lower common charges compared to the rest of the building. Don't let this opportunity pass you by and start living your best life!
